entity.name: Yuvraj Ghoghari
entity.description: Full-time open-source maintainer developing Tether, an extensible C99 ECS UI engine, with its independent Chitra rendering and Vinyasa layout projects.

projects.name: Tether
projects.description: A lightweight, extensible C99 user interface engine built on Entity Component System (ECS) architecture, format-independent scene parsing, the independent Vinyasa layout engine, and the Chitra 2D rendering subsystem.

channels.description: Direct bank transfer details provided securely to grant administrators upon formal agreement. Contact yuvrajghoghari@outlook.com with subject 'Tether Grant Funding'.

plans.name: Tether 6-Month Full-Time Development Grant
plans.description: Six-month full-time project grant covering maintainer compensation (INR 6,00,000) and dedicated development tooling (INR 72,000) to advance Tether's core architecture, layout, rendering, and multi-language capabilities through tested and documented milestone releases. Scope: M1 (1 mo, INR 1.12L): Core optimization, reusable memory modules, ECS lifecycle, and registry extensibility for custom widgets/events; M2 (2 mo, INR 2.24L): Independent Vinyasa layout engine using Primitive-Container-Slot architecture with Flex and Canvas presets and custom rule extensibility; M3 (1.5 mo, INR 1.68L): Chitra rendering enhancements including SDL3 backend, FreeType/HarfBuzz Unicode text shaping, BiDi processing, vectors, shaders, and separated animation; M4 (1.5 mo, INR 1.68L): Format-independent modular parsing, custom UI definitions, automated multi-language binding generator with CI merge gates, and tested milestone releases. Detailed plan: https://github.com/Yuvi-GD/Yuvi-GD/blob/main/funding-plan.md
